definitions.explanation: The home where one's parents live, or more broadly, the care and proximity of one's parents.

examples.japanese: {親元|おやもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。

⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{親元|おやもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started living alone after leaving my parents' home when I entered university.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{親元|おやもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}→当たり前：01685_atarimae⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧になって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, being at my parents' home was natural, but since I started working, opportunities to visit have decreased.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ (parent) + ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ (place of origin, side of). Often used in the context of leaving home for the first time — for college, work, or marriage. Carries an emotional nuance of parental care and the family nest.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親元|おやもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧: to leave one's parents' home
- {親元|おやもと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧: to live at one's parents' home
- {親元|おやもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to return to one's parents' home
- {親元|おやもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to go back to one's parents' place

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧: family home, parents' house — more neutral, refers to the house itself
- ⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧: hometown — broader, the place where one grew up
- {生家|せいか}: birthplace, house where one was born — specifically the birth home
